gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-bespoke-sans: Loose, scribbled charm up top, sharpened by what follows. Bespoke Sans is a refined plain sans with generous gaps where curves meet stems, comfortable in small doses but tiring if stretched much further.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-literata: Literata is a bookish classic serif with sturdy thin strokes and wide-mouthed curves, while Schoolbell scrawls above it. The hand-drawn heading loosens the page; the body tightens it.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-neco: Neco reads dignified and authoritative, its strokes swelling gently from hairline to stem. Under Schoolbell's monoline scrawl, a longer passage feels steady and formal, a little like a letter answered in a firmer hand.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-plein: Schoolbell's line has a steady, marker-like weight, like a pen that never lifts its pressure. Plein, a sans-serif with a clear channel into each round letter, can sit at a modest size without losing its tidy look.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-recia: Recia reads sharp and authoritative, its modulation faint until you look closely, and its openings stay generous at every weight. Beside Schoolbell's single-thickness scrawl, it keeps things grounded.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-rowan: Friendly and literary, Rowan opens every curve wide and keeps its thin strokes at about half the thick ones. Next to Schoolbell's bent-steel-rod lines, it feels bookish, though it was not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-spline-sans: Approachable from the first glance, Schoolbell sprawls casually while the body stays tidy. Spline Sans, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, reads contemporary and crisp, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-synonym: Schoolbell's open-mouthed e and tight letterfit make its hand-drawn line feel like a quick note in the margin. Synonym, a sans-serif of constant ink, handles the clean, dependable reading.
gen-gf-schoolbell-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its curves finishing well before they close, like cable bent into shapes. Schoolbell brings the hand-drawn looseness, while Outfit does the tidy work for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-schoolbell-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise. Its monoline strokes and curve endings kept well apart make a longer stretch feel crisp and orderly, though it was not meant for long paragraphs, beside Schoolbell's casual hand.
